listing_title: Spazioso Quadrilocale a Jesolo Paese — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / SPAZIOSO QUADRILOCALE A JESOLO PAESE FOR SALE · APARTMENT Spazioso Quadrilocale a Jesolo Paese JESOLO PAESE · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €240,000 Photos (15) Floor plans (1) 1 / 15 FLOOR AREA 100 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS F Overview Welcome to your home in Jesolo Paese! If you are looking for a residence where livability, independence of spaces, and everyday practicality come together, this four-room apartment is a concrete answer to the needs of a family or anyone seeking real living spaces year-round. Located in a strategic and quiet position, the property allows you to reach the heart of Jesolo Paese with just a 5-minute walk, along with schools, shops, supermarkets, and essential city services. At the same time, it takes only 10 minutes by car or via convenient bike paths to get to the sea. Situated on the raised ground floor of an elegant building surrounded by a pleasant communal garden, this apartment stands out for its generous sizes that are hard to find in recent constructions and for its excellent distribution of spaces. Upon entering through the front door, an initial hallway welcomes you and leads into the day area. Unlike modern open-spaces, here the environments are distinctly separated: on the left is a spacious kitchen while adjacent lies a large bright living room—a generous space that comfortably accommodates both a living area with sofas and TV as well as a dining table for special occasions. Both rooms in the day area boast practical access to an adjoining terrace. Continuing straight ahead, one door leads into the night zone hallway. The areas are practically distributed: The master bedroom offers generous dimensions with access to another private terrace alongside it is a comfortable double bedroom ideal for children or guests. Completing this sleeping quarter is a third single room—versatile enough to be used as an office space or hobby room or additional bedroom. The floor features two well-organized bathrooms consisting of an essential service bathroom and main bathroom complete with bathtub catering to all daily needs. To complete this property there’s also ample-sized double garage located on the ground floor. A spacious housing solution ready to welcome you with all comfort needed.
